method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Creates prematch timer, perks, medals and notification queue children. ShowMedals is allowed only when final killcam, game ended, killcam, POTM and scoreboard flags are all absent, then negates CodCasterEnabledAndProfileVarEqualTo(playernotifications,false). Visibility subscriptions request model_validation. Registers close, optional postload, returns self. This does not initialize a countdown or award medals; producer/helper/native behavior remains external.
